declarations.name: Theorem V1. The primitive residue curve has a rational quotient
declarations.scope: For all b>=2 and passport(2^2 1^(2b-2)),(b^2 1^2),T onN=2b+2 sheets, normalize the DT critical pair0,1 and use S=x+y,V=xy,U=S-1,W=V-U. The primitive residue equation, after forgetting the order of x,y, is the single rational graph V=b*B_b(t)/((t-1)^2*A_b(t)), U=-b*B_b(t)/((t-1)*A_b(t)),t=W/V, A_b=sum_(j0..b-1)(j+1)(b-j)t^j,B_b=sum_(j0..b)t^j. The cleared equation is linear inV and its coefficients have gcd exactly t-1 overC. Thus there is one geometric quotient component; no unproved ordered-root irreducibility is assumed. The imprimitive locus is exactly U0.

declarations.name: Lemma V2. Exact coefficient charts and uniform nonemptiness
declarations.scope: Every such normalized polynomial has the exact rational CRT chart E=P^2*((P^2)^(-1) modB^b), f=E/L,v=1/L, P=z(z-1),B=z^2-Sz+V,L=coeff_z^N E. Coprimality, discB!=0, L!=0 and the linear critical quotient A=f'/(NPB^(b-1)) give all exact exclusions, including w=f(alpha)!=0,v. Both sectors are uniformly nonempty overQ: primitive t2 has V=b*(2^(b+1)-1)/((b-2)*2^(b+1)+b+4) in(1,3), S1-V; imprimitive S1,V2. B is positive onR, a Rolle/weighted-mean argument puts the remaining critical point in(0,1), and positivity excludes w=v. Finite charts are controls, not the existence proof.

declarations.name: Theorem V3. Complete components, actual groups and exact sizes
declarations.scope: For every b>=2 there are exactly two absolute and two literal full-braid orbits. Putm=b+1,W=3*(2-indicator(b2)). Primitive: actual S_(2m), blocks1,2m,deck1, literal2Wm^2(3b-2),absoluteWm(3b-2). Imprimitive: actual S2 wr S_m,blocks1,m,2m,deck2,literalWm^2,absoluteWm. The rational quotient proof establishes primitive connectedness uniformly; U1-U2 give actual groups and exact count subtraction. W includes every distinct factor-type placement.

declarations.name: Theorem V4. Rational moduli coordinates and exceptional label action
declarations.scope: Both affine-quotient moduli components are rational overQ. Forb>2 exact fields areQ(t+1/t) primitive andQ(V) imprimitive. Reflection exchanges the DT critical pair and sends t to1/t. Forb2 also exchange equal heavy profiles: q=t+1/t maps to1/(q+2)-2, and V maps toV/(4V-1). Exact invariant coordinates are(q+2)+1/(q+2) and4V^2/(4V-1). No universal unmarked polynomial descent is asserted; coefficient charts retain their indicated finite markings.
